value.rationale: This is a complete exact, sharply arithmetic classification of the finite-torus global orders for two canonical maximal-connectivity graph families, uniform in node count and resolution. It resolves a natural question singled out by numerical period studies, exhibits a discrete n mod4 stability/doubling boundary and a sharp self-loop contrast, and supplies a short broadly useful valuation-lifting method. The result does not rely on a manufactured parameter slice or incremental finite enumeration.
